name: Blame
tagline: Invisible until someone breaks the build. Then their name, across every monitor you own.
description: It does nothing. No widget, no colour, nothing sitting in the corner being green at you. It waits. Then a pipeline breaks and it throws the culprit's name across every screen, BROKE THE BUILD! in letters the whole room can read, with a taunt underneath about what they've done this time. Twelve seconds later it tidies itself away, because a notice that never leaves is just wallpaper. Repeat offenders can be given taunts of their very own. They've earned them.
